psychological_meaning: Sulu is a vibrant, cheerful green that evokes feelings of freshness, vitality, and growth. It's a color that connects us to nature, promoting a sense of well-being and optimism. Sulu can also inspire creativity and a sense of renewal, making it a stimulating yet calming choice.

real_world_examples.title: Fresh Produce Packaging
real_world_examples.description: Sulu is often used on packaging for organic produce to convey freshness and natural goodness.

real_world_examples.title: Modern Office Space
real_world_examples.description: Accent walls in Sulu can brighten up a modern office, promoting creativity and a positive work environment.
